about.label: About Darshan
about.headline: I design products and bring them to life.
about.subtitle: I take ideas through research, UX decisions, and Figma design, then work with AI-assisted development to turn them into usable, launched products.

process.title: Understand the problem
process.description: I define the goal, explore users’ needs, and map out what the product needs to do.

process.title: Shape the experience
process.description: I organize the flows, structure the content, and create interfaces that feel easy to use.

process.title: Refine the details
process.description: I review the design, improve what feels unclear, and make each screen consistent and polished.

experience.label: Experience
experience.headline: Where I've worked
experience.intro: I've worked with teams on real products and learned at every step.

items.detail: Moved from UI/UX intern to a full-time designer. Contributed to web and mobile interface designs, explored user flows, and prepared Figma designs with feedback from the team.
Designed responsive client websites and visual assets while working closely with the wider creative team.
Formal training in UI/UX and graphic design.
Affiliated to the University of Madras
